channelDialog.name: Channel name
channelDialog.topicPlaceholder: Let everyone know how to use this channel

nsfw.label: NSFW channel
nsfw.hint: Images, videos, GIFs and embeds in it are blurred until clicked, unless someone turns that off in their settings.

private.label: Private channel
private.hint: Only the roles you pick (and admins) will see it.
private.listHint: Who may edit its tasks is set in its Permissions tab (Edit Tasks).
private.docHint: Who may write documents is set in its Permissions tab (Create Documents).

voice.bitrateHint: How much sound each microphone sends: 64 kbps is default. Higher sounds clearer and uses more data.
voice.bitrateHighHint: Above 96 kbps voices hardly sound different (the microphone is mono); it suits music. Everyone in the channel uses more data.
voice.userLimitHint: Once it's full nobody else can join, except people who can manage channels.
voice.regionHint: The voice server the channel's calls go through: the closest to most of its people sounds best. Changing it moves everyone in it there (a moment of silence).

channelPermissions.privateHint: Only the roles and members allowed "View Channel" below (and admins) will see it.
channelPermissions.locked: This role is as high as yours or higher.

VIEW_CHANNEL.label: View Channels
VIEW_CHANNEL.description: Lets members see channels (private channels aside).

MANAGE_CHANNELS.label: Manage Channels
MANAGE_CHANNELS.description: Lets members create, edit and delete channels and categories.

MANAGE_ROLES.label: Manage Roles
MANAGE_ROLES.description: Lets members create and edit roles below their highest role, give them out, and change channel permissions.

MANAGE_GUILD.label: Manage Guild
MANAGE_GUILD.description: Lets members change the guild's name and icon, and see and revoke all invites.

MANAGE_EMOJIS.label: Manage Emoji
MANAGE_EMOJIS.description: Lets members add, rename and remove the guild's custom emoji.

MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.label: Manage Webhooks
MANAGE_WEBHOOKS.description: Lets members create, edit and delete webhooks, which let other apps and services post messages in text channels.

VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.label: View Audit Log
VIEW_AUDIT_LOG.description: Lets members see the guild's audit log: who deleted which messages, and who changed the guild's settings, channels, roles, invites, emoji and webhooks, or kicked and banned people.

CREATE_INVITE.label: Create Invite
CREATE_INVITE.description: Lets members invite people to this guild.

KICK_MEMBERS.label: Kick Members
KICK_MEMBERS.description: Lets members remove people ranked below them. They can rejoin with an invite.

BAN_MEMBERS.label: Ban Members
BAN_MEMBERS.description: Lets members remove people ranked below them for good (until unbanned).

SEND_MESSAGES.label: Send Messages
SEND_MESSAGES.description: Lets members post in text channels.

MANAGE_MESSAGES.label: Manage Messages
MANAGE_MESSAGES.description: Lets members delete other people's messages.

PIN_MESSAGES.label: Pin Messages
PIN_MESSAGES.description: Lets members pin and unpin messages.

CREATE_THREADS.label: Create Threads
CREATE_THREADS.description: Lets members start threads: side conversations from a message, or on their own.

SEND_MESSAGES_IN_THREADS.label: Send Messages in Threads
SEND_MESSAGES_IN_THREADS.description: Lets members post in threads. Archiving, renaming and deleting other people's threads follows Manage Messages.

MENTION_EVERYONE.label: Mention @everyone, @here and All Roles
MENTION_EVERYONE.description: Lets members notify everyone in a channel (@everyone), everyone online there (@here), and any role, even ones not set to be mentionable.

CONNECT.label: Connect
CONNECT.description: Lets members join voice channels and hear others.

SPEAK.label: Speak
SPEAK.description: Lets members talk in voice channels. Without it they can only listen.

LISTEN.label: Listen
LISTEN.description: Lets members hear the others in voice channels. Everyone has it unless you take it away; a bot only hears voice channels if it's given this.

STREAM.label: Video
STREAM.description: Lets members turn on their camera and share their screen in voice channels.

QUEUE_VIDEOS.label: Queue Videos
QUEUE_VIDEOS.description: Lets members in a voice channel add YouTube videos to Watch Together's queue, and remove the ones they added.

MANAGE_QUEUE.label: Manage Queue
MANAGE_QUEUE.description: Lets members in a voice channel reorder Watch Together's queue and remove anyone's videos from it.

CONTROL_PLAYBACK.label: Control Playback
CONTROL_PLAYBACK.description: Lets members in a voice channel play, pause, skip and jump around in the video everyone is watching together.

EDIT_TASKS.label: Edit Tasks
EDIT_TASKS.description: Lets members add, edit, assign, complete, reorder and delete tasks in list channels. Commenting on tasks follows Send Messages.

CREATE_DOCUMENTS.label: Create Documents
CREATE_DOCUMENTS.description: Lets members write documents in document channels and edit their own. Editing and deleting other people's follows Manage Messages; replying follows Send Messages.

CREATE_EVENTS.label: Create Events
CREATE_EVENTS.description: Lets members schedule events (in voice channels they can join, or somewhere else) and edit, start and cancel their own.

MANAGE_EVENTS.label: Manage Events
MANAGE_EVENTS.description: Lets members edit, start, end and cancel anyone's events.

MANAGE_LEVELS.label: Manage Levels
MANAGE_LEVELS.description: Lets members set anyone's XP and level. Mostly for bots that hand out XP.

ADMINISTRATOR.label: Administrator
ADMINISTRATOR.description: Every permission, in every channel, whatever the channel settings. Handle with care.

clear.title: Clear old entries
clear.hint: Only you, the owner, can do this. Everyone who can see the log will see that you did.

confirm.days30: Delete every audit log entry older than 30 days? This can't be undone.
confirm.days90: Delete every audit log entry older than 90 days? This can't be undone.
confirm.year: Delete every audit log entry older than a year? This can't be undone.
confirm.everything: Delete the whole audit log? This can't be undone.

categoryDialog.name: Category name
categoryDialog.deleteHint: Deleting a category keeps its channels.

webhooks.tooBig: Pictures can be up to 8 MB.
webhooks.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it. Your browser may not allow it here.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.confirmDelete: Delete {{name}}? Anything using its URL stops working.
webhooks.intro: Webhooks let other apps and services post messages into #{{name}}. Each has its own name and picture, and a secret URL the app posts to. Anyone with the URL can post here, so keep it private.

hint.text: A new channel just below this one, with the same topic, settings and permissions. Its messages aren't copied.
hint.list: A new channel just below this one, with the same topic, settings and permissions. Its tasks aren't copied.
hint.doc: A new channel just below this one, with the same topic, settings and permissions. Its documents aren't copied.
hint.voice: A new channel just below this one, with the same settings and permissions.

emoji.wrongType: {{file}}: emoji must be PNG, GIF, WebP, JPEG or AVIF images.
emoji.intro: Add up to {{max}} custom emoji anyone in the guild can use. PNG, GIF, WebP, JPEG or AVIF up to 10 MB; they're shrunk to 128×128, and animated ones stay animated. Names are letters, numbers and underscores.

guildSettings.title: Guild settings
guildSettings.iconNotImage: The icon must be an image.
guildSettings.iconTooBig: The icon must be under 8 MB.
guildSettings.deleteHint: This deletes every channel and message. It can't be undone. Type the guild's name to confirm.

joinLog.title: Join log
joinLog.hint: A channel where the guild says who joined, as they join. Everyone who can see that channel sees it.
joinLog.leavesHint: Leaving, being kicked and being banned all show as "left": the audit log keeps who did what.

vanity.title: Vanity URL
vanity.hint: A permanent invite link of your choosing: it never expires and can be used any number of times. Only the guild's owner can set it.
vanity.none: This guild has no vanity URL.

guildSettings.noPermission: You don't have permission to change anything here.

invite.copyFailed: Couldn't copy; select the link and copy it yourself.
invite.title: Invite friends to {{name}}
invite.linkLabel: Send a guild invite link to a friend
invite.vanityLabel: Or share the guild's vanity URL
invite.vanityHint: Never expires, any number of uses.

all.label: All messages
all.hint: A notification for every message in the channels you can see.

mentions.label: Only @mentions
mentions.hint: When someone mentions you, @everyone or @here, or one of your roles.

none.label: Nothing
none.hint: No notifications from this guild. Mentions still show in red.

notifications.deviceHint: Notifications need to be turned on for this device in Settings.

roles.listHint: Members use the colour of their highest role. Drag to reorder.
roles.locked: This role is as high as your highest role, so you can't change it.
roles.everyoneHint: Everyone in the guild has these, whatever other roles they have.
roles.botRoleHint: The bot {{name}}'s own role, given when it was added. Its permissions can be changed; it can't be deleted or given to anyone else, and goes when the bot leaves.
roles.name: Role name
roles.hoist: Display role members separately from online members
roles.mentionableHint: Members with "Mention @everyone, @here and All Roles" can always mention it.

mute.untilTurnedOn: Until I turn it back on
